args.prompt: Create one production 2D combat animation sprite sheet of THE PAIN from ORIGINAL Metal Gear Solid 3 Snake Eater (2004 PS2). Closest 1:1 ORIGINAL costume/anatomy supported by the supplied canonical Shinkawa drawing and Konami original game-model color image. Never remake/Delta. Huge stocky muscular broad-shouldered middle-aged man, head proportionately small. Phase ONE fully covered head: dark charcoal tight BALACLAVA covering head, mouth and nose with only narrow flesh strip at eyes, no bare face and no gas mask. ORIGINAL color image overrides monochrome interpretation: full black/charcoal long sleeved padded/textured field suit, orange ochre/yellow sleeveless flotation-like heavy chest vest with straps and dark gray upper shoulder protection, 2 horizontal ochre cartridge rows across the chest/belly, ochre rectangular pouches at hips/back, black wide belt, dark gray trousers reinforced knees, black combat gloves and plain black tall boots. Keep recognizable original rounded massive torso, broad thick upper arms, tight black head and ochre front breast panel. NO bare arms, armor redesign, helmet, scarf, goggles, modern military plates, weapons, guns, magic, horns, bee aura or floating insects on body. Crisp ink contour and restrained detailed cel shaded polished fighting game artwork, readable dark contour on true transparent alpha, consistent costume and scale, exact head and fully visible boots. Output ONE PNG: exactly 4 columns by 3 rows, 12 entirely isolated full body figures, one per equal cell, no touching. All characters face SCREEN RIGHT (nose, chest and front foot face right), mild side three-quarter so vest remains visible; do not mix directions. Leave large TRANSPARENT OUTER MARGINS and broad transparent gutters, each full figure stays within own cell even hands/feet, never clipped. No labels, text, boxes, checkerboard, background, ground shadows. Row-major poses are ALL original-costume CQC fighting adaptation, no borrowed lore: 0 punch startup right fist beside chest; 1 punch ACTIVE front right fist fully straight horizontally at chest height; 2 punch recovery arm retracts; 3 heavy wind-up weight rear leg right fist drawn well back; 4 heavy ACTIVE right forearm horizontal forceful straight punch front arm fully extended; 5 heavy recovery feet settle right arm bending back; 6 low strike start deep squat right knee bent; 7 low ACTIVE very low grounded long sweeping front left leg extended toward SCREEN RIGHT and bent rear leg, arms balance; 8 low recovery grounded squat left leg returning; 9 hurt stagger backward torso recoil still SCREEN RIGHT, knees bend; 10 KO falling backward sitting near ground head still to screen right; 11 KO lying on back diagonal full body, head at SCREEN RIGHT and both boots at SCREEN LEFT. Exactly 12 single isolated complete figures on true transparent background. Greater space in low and KO cells to contain entire full-body limbs.
